200:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
201:     if (words.empty()) {
202:         return std::nullopt;

204: 
205:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
206:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
207:         return std::nullopt;

211:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
212:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
213:         bool is_phrase = true;
214: 
215:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
216:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
217:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
218:                 return std::nullopt;
219:             }

221:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
222:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.chapter_id == start.chapter_id &&
223:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
224:             });

226:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
227:                 is_phrase = false;
228:                 break;
229:             }
230: 
231:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
232:         }
233: 
234:         if (is_phrase) {
235:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());

321: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_near(
322:     std::string_view key1, std::string_view key2, size_t dis) const {
323:     const std::string word1 = normalize_word(key1);
324:     const std::string word2 = normalize_word(key2);
325:     if (word1.empty() || word2.empty()) {
326:         return std::nullopt;
327:     }
328: 
329:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
330:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
331:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
332:         return std::nullopt;
333:     }
334: 
335:     std::vector<Index> matches;
336: 
337:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
338:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
339:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.chapter_id != second.chapter_id ||
340:                 first.line != second.line) {
341:                 continue;
342:             }
343: 
344:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
345:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
346:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
347:             if (distance <= dis) {
348:                 matches.push_back(first);
349:                 matches.push_back(second);
350:             }
351:         }
352:     }
353:

369:     if (idx.line >= book.lines.size() || is_blank_line(book.lines[idx.line])) {

374:     while (cur_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_begin - 1])) {
